guarantees.claim: When app_id matches the loop index i, app_o[i].ready is driven as app_data_ready | fsm_data_ready.
When app_id matches the loop index i, app_o[i].done is driven as app_digest_done | fsm_digest_done_q.
When app_id matches the loop index i, app_o[i].digest_share0 is driven as app_digest[0].
When app_id matches the loop index i, app_o[i].digest_share1 is driven as app_digest[1].
When app_id matches the loop index i, app_o[i].error is driven as error_i | fsm_digest_done_q | sparse_fsm_error_o | service_rejected_error.
For all other i (i != app_id), app_o[i] is driven to all zeros (ready=0, done=0, digest_share0='0, digest_share1='0, error=0).

assumptions.claim: app_id is a valid index within [0, NumAppIntf-1].
assumptions.risk: If app_id is out-of-bounds, no interface is selected, all app_o outputs remain zero, and the consumer may hang or miss completions.

assumptions.claim: fsm_digest_done_q is only asserted when a genuine error condition exists, as implied by the comment 'if fsm asserts done, should be an error case.'
assumptions.risk: If fsm_digest_done_q is asserted without an actual error, app_o[i].error incorrectly becomes high while done is also high, misleading the consumer into taking error recovery for a normal completion.
If NumAppIntf == 0, the for-loop does not execute, app_o is not assigned, leading to latched behavior or undriven outputs in the combinational process.

uncertain_points.claim: The condition under which fsm_digest_done_q is asserted and considered an error is unclear. The comment 'if fsm asserts done, should be an error case' lacks definition.
uncertain_points.risk: Consumer interprets done+error incorrectly, leading to wrong protocol handling or missed error recovery.

uncertain_points.claim: app_digest[1:0] are output as digest shares unconditionally when i == app_id. If these contain secret shares (e.g., masked digest), they may be exposed without any security gating.
uncertain_points.risk: Unauthorized disclosure of secret key material or sensitive intermediate values to the application interface.

uncertain_points.claim: If NumAppIntf is 0, the for-loop body never executes and app_o is undriven, likely causing latches or unconnected outputs.
uncertain_points.risk: Synthesis infers latches or leaves app_o floating, leading to functional failure.
